answer.book: Ioannis de Laet's De gemmis et lapidibus libri duo (Lugduni Batavorum, 1647), prefaced by a dedication, a preface, two chapter indexes, a prolegomenon, Pliny excerpts and errata, and by Theophrastus's De lapidibus in Greek and Latin with brief annotations, then Laet's two books of numbered chapters on gems and stones.

entries.title: Ioannis de Laet Antverpiani de gemmis et lapidibus libri duo.
